title: Selling Digital Downloads in Pakistan: A Step-by-Step Deployment Guide
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling digital products from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Zimbabwe is fully operational with sovereign commerce infrastructure that has no geographic restrictions.

content.text: In Pakistan, where Stripe and PayPal restrictions prevent creators from selling digital products internationally, a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is the answer. This guide shows you how to deploy a blockchain-based payment and delivery pipeline that removes geographic barriers entirely and lets you sell digital downloads to anyone, anywhere. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare infrastructure, you'll unlock new revenue streams and avoid platform risks. You'll learn how to set up a payment and delivery pipeline, go live, and scale your infrastructure. This guide assumes you have a basic understanding of digital commerce and blockchain technology, but no prior experience with NOWPayments or Cloudflare infrastructure is necessary. By the end of this guide, you'll have a fully functional, sovereign digital commerce stack that lets you sell digital downloads to anyone, anywhere in the world.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal often fail creators in Pakistan because they're designed for Western markets and enforce restrictive policies that block international transactions. In contrast, a blockchain-based payment infrastructure like NOWPayments lets you accept 300+ cryptocurrencies from anywhere in the world, without relying on intermediaries or exposing your customers to risks. By leveraging Cloudflare infrastructure, you'll also get free hosting and backend logic, as well as automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This means you can sell digital downloads to anyone, anywhere, without worrying about platform restrictions or transaction fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to sign up for a NOWPayments account and obtain a NOWPayments API key. You'll also need to create a Cloudflare account and set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site. Additionally, you'll need to configure your payment and delivery pipeline by specifying your cryptocurrency, payment amount, and delivery settings. You can find more information on these requirements in the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints plus 7 templates for building, deploying, and scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to create a new NOWPayments webhook and configure your payment settings. You'll also need to set up a delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which will handle file delivery and automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Make sure to test your payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly before going live to ensure that everything is working as expected.
You can sell digital downloads in Pakistan without a Stripe or PayPal account by leveraging a blockchain-based payment infrastructure like NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to go live by deploying your infrastructure to a Cloudflare Pages site or GitHub Pages site. You'll also need to test your payment and delivery pipeline one last time to ensure that everything is working as expected. When you receive your first transaction, make sure to verify the payment manually to ensure that everything is working correctly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, you'll need to scale your payment and delivery pipeline to handle increased traffic and transaction volumes. You can do this by upgrading your NOWPayments plan, adding more workers to your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script setup, and optimizing your delivery pipeline for better performance. Make sure to monitor your infrastructure closely and adjust your scaling strategy as needed to ensure that everything is running smoothly.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer. The delivery email arrives in the buyer's inbox within 30 seconds. Nothing in this sequence requires the buyer to have a bank account, a credit card, or a PayPal account. Nothing requires you to be in a supported country.
With Cloudflare infrastructure, you can get free hosting and backend logic, as well as automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
